steps.command:
if command -v useradd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  add="useradd --create-home --uid 10001 --shell /bin/bash runner"
else
  add="adduser -D -u 10001 -s /bin/sh runner"
fi
if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then
  $add
else
  sudo -n $add
fi
